title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 3: backsliding Israel and treacherous Judah, the call to return, and the promise of shepherds after God's heart.

questions.text: Although the people had played the prostitute with many lovers, what did Yahweh still say?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "you have played the prostitute with many lovers; yet return again to me."

answers.text: "I will never look on you again"
"Your land will be sold to strangers"

questions.text: What had been withheld because the land was polluted?
questions.explanation: The verse says the showers were withheld and there was no latter rain, yet the people had a prostitute's forehead and refused to be ashamed.

answers.text: The showers and the latter rain

questions.text: In the days of which king did Yahweh speak about what backsliding Israel had done?
questions.explanation: Yahweh spoke in the days of Josiah the king, asking, "Have you seen that which backsliding Israel has done?"

questions.text: What did Yahweh give backsliding Israel because of her adultery?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he had put her away and given her a certificate of divorce, yet Judah was not afraid.

answers.text: A yoke of iron for her neck
A cup of wrath to drink

questions.text: Who had shown herself more righteous, according to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Backsliding Israel has shown herself more righteous than treacherous Judah."

answers.text: Treacherous Judah, more righteous than Israel
The nations, more righteous than both
Backsliding Israel, more righteous than treacherous Judah

questions.text: Toward which direction was the speaker told to proclaim, "Return, you backsliding Israel"?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Go, and proclaim these words toward the north," promising not to keep anger forever.

questions.text: What did Yahweh promise to take from a city and from a family?
questions.explanation: He said, "I will take one of you from a city, and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion."

answers.text: A tithe from a city and an offering from a family
Ten from a city and five from a family
One from a city and two from a family, to bring them to Zion
The firstborn from a city and the eldest from a family

questions.text: What kind of shepherds did Yahweh promise to give?
questions.explanation: He promised shepherds according to his heart, who would feed them with knowledge and understanding.

answers.text: Shepherds chosen only from the house and line of David
Shepherds according to his heart, feeding with knowledge and understanding
Shepherds who would rule the flock with a rod of iron
Shepherds taken from among the priests and the Levites

questions.text: What will Jerusalem be called at that time?
questions.explanation: The verse says they will call Jerusalem "Yahweh's Throne," and all the nations will be gathered to it.

questions.text: Where does the confession at the end of the chapter say the salvation of Israel truly is?
questions.explanation: The people confess, "Truly help from the hills, the tumult on the mountains, is in vain. Truly the salvation of Israel is in Yahweh our God."

answers.text: In the ark of the covenant
